name: outlook-local-mcp
description: Manage Microsoft Outlook calendars, events, and email directly from Claude. Runs entirely on your local machine — data stays on your device.
long_description:
A local MCP server that connects Claude to Microsoft Outlook through Microsoft Graph.

## Features

- **Calendar and mail operations** with granular per-account policies
- **Multi-account lifecycle** with process-bound browser, device-code, and authorization-code sessions
- **Validated shared resources** using exact metadata-only Graph routes
- **Optional embedded web UI** for local account, permission, authentication, and shared-resource management
- **Recurrence and Teams support** for calendar workflows

## Privacy & Security

- Runs as a single Go binary on your machine — no cloud relay or proxy
- Web administration binds only to IPv4 loopback and stops with MCP
- OAuth tokens are stored in your OS keychain (macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager)
- User.Read is required; calendar, mail, and shared scopes are requested only for explicitly enabled policies

tools.name: calendar
tools.description: Calendar operations for Microsoft Outlook via Microsoft Graph. Owner-primary and explicitly selected mounted calendar list/get/search reads use account-scoped aliases, exact mailbox-view routes, and signed target-bound event references. Organizational mounted aliases with manage capability also support create/update/reschedule/delete only when Graph explicitly reports zero attendees and no online-meeting capability, on the exact recipient-view route; shared meeting actions remain excluded. Omitting an alias preserves own-calendar behavior. Required operation: help (detailed docs), list_calendars, list_events, get_event, search_events, create_event, update_event, delete_event, respond_event, reschedule_event, create_meeting, update_meeting, cancel_meeting, reschedule_meeting, get_free_busy.

tools.name: mail
tools.description: Mail operations for Microsoft Outlook via Microsoft Graph. The selected target's exact action policy authorizes each operation. Organizational shared-mail reads, drafts, attachments, ordinary filing, One-Click Archive, Deleted Items trash and restore, separately confirmed permanent deletion, and complete-snapshot human-reviewed shared send use exact owner-view routes and signed target-bound references. Move-like actions return Graph's replacement message reference; irreversible or non-idempotent actions are never retried ambiguously. Includes resumable own-draft attachment upload and backward-compatible own-mail send_draft.

tools.name: account
tools.description: Account management for Microsoft accounts. Configure explicit own-calendar and own-mail permissions, authenticate the deterministic scope union, inspect process-bound auth sessions, manage shared resources, and run observational Graph discovery and direct validation.

tools.name: system
tools.description: Local read-only system diagnostics and embedded documentation access. Required operation: help, status, list_docs, search_docs, or get_docs. Account authentication and auth-code completion are provided by the account domain.

client_id.title: Microsoft Application (Client) ID
client_id.description: The app used to access Microsoft Graph. Default: 'outlook-desktop' (Microsoft Office, works out of the box with device_code auth). Use 'outlook-local-mcp' for the project's own app registration. To use browser auth, register your own app in Entra ID with http://localhost redirect URI and paste the client ID here.

tenant_id.title: Entra ID Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Your Entra ID tenant. Use 'common' (default) for any Microsoft account, 'organizations' for work/school only, or 'consumers' for personal accounts only. Advanced: paste a specific tenant GUID to restrict access to a single organization.

auth_method.title: Authentication Method
auth_method.description: How you sign in to Microsoft. 'device_code' (default): visit a URL and enter a code — works everywhere, no app registration needed. 'browser': opens your browser automatically — requires your own app registration with http://localhost redirect URI. 'auth_code': manual flow for headless/remote environments.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Your timezone for calendar operations (IANA format). Use 'auto' to detect from your system, or specify explicitly, e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Tokyo'. Defaults to 'auto'.

web_ui_enabled.title: Local Account Web UI
web_ui_enabled.description: Enable the loopback-only account and permission management page. Disabled by default.

web_ui_port.title: Local Account Web UI Port
web_ui_port.description: IPv4 loopback port for the optional account web UI.

attachment_roots.title: Allowed Attachment Directories
attachment_roots.description: OS path-list of directories from which mail.add_attachment may read local files. Empty disables local upload.
